packageRules.description: Group all AndroidX libraries into a single PR - they're versioned/released together upstream anyway, so reviewing (and testing) them one at a time would just be needless churn.
Group the Kotlin Gradle plugin with the Kotlin stdlib/compose-compiler - they're required to always match exactly, so bumping one without the other would just break the build.
Group everything under app/build.gradle.kts's own Gradle plugins (AGP, etc.) separately from regular library dependencies above.
GitHub Actions used by the CI/release workflows themselves.
fastlane and its dependencies (Gemfile, see fastlane/Fastfile) - the Play Store upload tooling, versioned independently of anything in the Android app itself.

Major version bumps need a human to actually read the changelog for breaking changes (e.g. a new AGP/Kotlin major version) - never auto-merged, unlike minor/patch housekeeping could be configured to be later.
